widgets_values:
NEW opt-in template; no old workflow, Core Guide or sampler algorithm changed.
Use one legal 5s/24fps source. SourceClock observes actual CFR; Conform once holds4 tail frames to124 and reports audio padding.
LOW448x256 and HIGH actual learned1.2x geometry share the SAME complete frame-map, not the same pixel hash.
Frame72=3s in the target. Both Core AddGuide nodes append to fresh conditioning before their BasicGuider.
Audio1=complete source dialogue; Audio2=separate voice sample; final mux=original source AUDIO, not decoded latent.
This is not arbitrary VFR/clock, hard pose/identity/voice lock or PCM-exact AAC qualification.
EAV / Relay remain externally connectable, neither is applied by default. KJ and existing assets required.
Human picture/pose/lip-sync/voice review remains necessary; no automatic PASS.
